step1.title: Basic Information
step1.subtitle: Tell us about your content
step1.isOfficialEnglish: Is this the official English title?
step1.officialEnglishCheckbox: This English title is official (not a direct translation)
step1.officialEnglishHelper: Check this if the title has been officially published in English
step1.rightsHolderSubtitle: Who owns the rights to this title?
step1.rightsBusinessSubtitle: Information about available rights and target markets
step1.rightsAvailableHelper: Select all types of rights that are available for licensing or adaptation
step1.platformsSubtitle: Where is this title currently published? Add platform URLs and metrics.
step1.tip1: Provide both Korean and English titles for better searchability
step1.tip2: If adapted from a novel, include the original source title
step1.tip3: Add all platforms where your title is published for visibility
step1.tip4: Include view counts and subscriber numbers to showcase popularity

step2.title: Story Details
step2.subtitle: Share the deeper aspects of your story
step2.contentDetailsSubtitle: Brief descriptions to help buyers discover your title
step2.taglineHelper: A catchy one-liner that captures your story's essence
step2.synopsisHelper: A short summary of your story (2-3 paragraphs)
step2.descriptionHelper: A more detailed description with plot points and character info
step2.notesHelper: Any additional information for potential buyers
step2.storyBackgroundSubtitle: What inspired this story and what themes does it explore?
step2.inspirationPlaceholder: What inspired you to create this story? (personal experiences, historical events, other media, etc.)
step2.inspirationHelper: Share the creative spark behind your story
step2.importantIssues: Does it address any important issues?
step2.importantIssuesPlaceholder: What important issues or themes does your story address? (social justice, mental health, identity, etc.)
step2.importantIssuesHelper: Themes that resonate with modern audiences
step2.comparableTitlesSubtitle: What existing titles is your story similar to? (e.g., "Tower of God meets Solo Leveling")
step2.worldBuildingSubtitle: Help buyers visualize your story's world
step2.settingDescription: Please describe the setting of your story (time, place, key locations)
step2.settingPlaceholder: Describe the time period, location, and key settings where your story takes place...
step2.settingHelper: Include time period, location type (urban/rural/fantasy realm), and atmosphere
step2.worldLore: Please describe the "rules" or lore of your world - magic systems, supernatural forces, sci-fi concepts, etc.
step2.worldLorePlaceholder: Describe the history, culture, and rules of your story's world...
step2.worldLoreHelper: Background information that enriches the setting
step2.supernaturalConcepts: Are there any supernatural or sci-fi concepts that separates this story from conventional reality? If so, is there any "lore" or "twist" or "big idea" or "high concept" crucial to understanding the story?
step2.supernaturalPlaceholder: Describe any magic systems, supernatural forces, futuristic technology, or sci-fi concepts...
step2.supernaturalHelper: Special abilities, magic systems, advanced technology, etc.
step2.mainCharactersSubtitle: Detailed information about your story's main characters
step2.tip1: Setting description is required - be specific about time and place
step2.tip2: Add at least one character with detailed demographics
step2.tip3: Comparable titles help buyers understand your story's genre and appeal
step2.tip4: Include diverse character backgrounds to showcase representation
step2.tip5: Describe your world's unique rules if it's fantasy or sci-fi

step3.title: Narrative Structure
step3.subtitle: Help buyers understand your story's narrative flow and how it develops from beginning to end.
step3.storyStructureSubtitle: Provide a high-level summary of your story's beginning, middle, and end
step3.storyStructurePlaceholder:
Example format:

BEGINNING: Introduce protagonist in their ordinary world, inciting incident occurs...

MIDDLE: Protagonist faces escalating challenges, key relationships develop...

END: Climax and resolution, how conflicts are resolved...
step3.storyStructureTip: Tip: Break down your story into three acts. Describe key plot points, turning points, and how the story progresses from setup to resolution.
step3.plannedEndingCompleted: How does your completed story end?
step3.plannedEndingOngoing: For ongoing series, describe how you plan to end the story
step3.ongoingRequiredMessage: Since your title is marked as ongoing, please describe how you plan to conclude the story. This helps buyers understand the long-term vision.
step3.endingPlaceholderOngoing: Describe how you plan to end your ongoing story...
step3.endingHelper: Avoid major spoilers, but provide enough detail to show you have a clear vision
step3.narrativeArcSubtitle: How does your story's tension and stakes escalate?
step3.narrativeArcPlaceholder: Describe the emotional or dramatic arc of your story... (rising tension, stakes, character growth, etc.)
step3.narrativeArcHelper: Examples: redemption arc, coming-of-age journey, revenge quest, mystery unraveling
step3.tip1: Story structure is required - provide a clear beginning/middle/end summary
step3.tip2: Planned ending is required for ongoing series to show your vision
step3.tip3: Focus on major plot points and turning points, not every detail
step3.tip4: Describe how conflicts escalate and resolve
step3.tip5: Show character growth and transformation throughout the narrative
step3.tip6: Balance detail with brevity - buyers want clarity, not spoilers

step4.title: Existing Materials
step4.subtitle: Share any creative documents, source materials, or external links that provide more context about your title.
step4.creativeDocumentsSubtitle: Upload PDFs, story bibles, outlines, scripts, or other documents
step4.externalLinksSubtitle: Add links to interviews, reviews, wikis, or other online resources
step4.tip1: Upload story bibles, outlines, or scripts to help buyers evaluate your content
step4.tip2: Mark sensitive materials as "Shareable with NDA" for controlled access
step4.tip3: Add links to interviews, reviews, or fan wikis for additional context
step4.tip4: Press releases and media coverage help showcase your title's reach
step4.tip5: All files must be under 10MB (PDF, Word, or TXT format)

step5.title: Content & Creator Profile
step5.subtitle: Showcase your title's success and your credentials as a creator to help buyers understand your track record.
step5.salesRecordsPlaceholder: Any notable sales figures, download numbers, or monetization milestones...
step5.salesRecordsHelper: e.g., "10 million downloads", "Top 10 on platform for 6 months"
step5.merchandisePlaceholder: Any merchandise, toy deals, or licensing agreements...
step5.printEditionDetailsPlaceholder: Publisher, release date, number of volumes, special editions...
step5.mediaCoveragePlaceholder: Any press coverage, articles, or media mentions...
step5.mediaCoverageHelper: News articles, reviews, podcast appearances, etc.
step5.celebrityEndorsementsPlaceholder: Any notable figures who have endorsed or promoted your title...
step5.creatorProfileSubtitle: Highlight your overall credentials and track record as a creator
step5.industryRecognitionPlaceholder: Any other notable achievements, collaborations, or industry recognition...
step5.industryRecognitionHelper: Keynote speeches, industry partnerships, mentorship programs, etc.
step5.tip1: Quantify achievements when possible (numbers, dates, rankings)
step5.tip2: Include awards at both title and creator level to showcase expertise
step5.tip3: Sales records and view counts demonstrate market viability
step5.tip4: Media coverage and endorsements add credibility
step5.tip5: Your overall creator profile helps buyers assess your track record
step5.tip6: Don't be shy - this is your chance to shine!
step5.almostDoneMessage: Once you complete this step, you'll be able to review and submit your title information. Your draft will be saved automatically as you work.
